# The residue subfield generated by the residue field of a fixed field (M250.001)

Let `K` be a nonarchimedean local field, `Ω = SeparableClosure K` its
separable closure, and `A = localSeparableValuationSubring K` the valuation
ring on `Ω` chosen for finite local reciprocity. For a closed subgroup `H` of
the absolute Galois group `Gal(Ω / K)`, let `E` be the fixed field of `H`.
The residue-action exact sequence attaches two residue fields to `A`, one over
`K` and one over `E`, and maps both into the residue field `λ` of `A`. This
module defines the subfield of `λ` that the residue field over `E` generates
over the residue field over `K`:

- `Langlands.NYLL.LocalClassFieldTheory.localAbstractFixedResidueIntermediateField K H`
  is the intermediate field of `λ` over `κ_K`, where
  `κ_K = decompositionResidueField K A`, generated by the image of
  `κ_E = decompositionResidueField E A` under its structure map to `λ`.

In Lean:

```lean
variable (K : Type) [Field K] [ValuativeRel K] [TopologicalSpace K]
  [IsNonarchimedeanLocalField K]

noncomputable def localAbstractFixedResidueIntermediateField
    (H : ClosedSubgroup (Gal(SeparableClosure K/K))) :
    IntermediateField
      (decompositionResidueField K (localSeparableValuationSubring K))
      (selectedResidueField (localSeparableValuationSubring K)) := by
  let E := abstractFixedField K (SeparableClosure K) H
  let A := localSeparableValuationSubring K
  let k := decompositionResidueField K A
  let Omega := selectedResidueField A
  let kE := decompositionResidueField E A
  exact IntermediateField.adjoin k
    (Set.range (algebraMap kE Omega))
```

The `let`s are abbreviations only. Unfolded, the value is

```lean
IntermediateField.adjoin
  (decompositionResidueField K (localSeparableValuationSubring K))
  (Set.range (algebraMap
    (decompositionResidueField (abstractFixedField K (SeparableClosure K) H)
      (localSeparableValuationSubring K))
    (selectedResidueField (localSeparableValuationSubring K))))
```

A development probe checked this equation by `rfl`. In the source's Lean
code the ambient residue field `λ` is the local variable `Omega`. In this
Markdown `Ω` names the separable closure.

## The objects involved

All of the following are already published:

- `localSeparableValuationSubring K : ValuationSubring (SeparableClosure K)`
  (M249.006, module
  `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.LocalClassFieldTheory.Finite.LocalReciprocity.LocalResidueDatum.U006.Definitions`)
  is the chosen valuation ring `A` on `Ω`: the pullback, along
  `SeparableClosure K → AlgebraicClosure K`, of a valuation ring on the
  algebraic closure that extends the valuation of `K`.
- `abstractFixedField K (SeparableClosure K) H : IntermediateField K (SeparableClosure K)`
  (M099.001, module
  `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.LocalClassFieldTheory.Finite.LocalReciprocity.FiniteAbstractFixedField.Initial.Definitions`)
  is `IntermediateField.fixedField H.toSubgroup`, the fixed field `E` of `H`.
  The definition uses it as a field in its own right, with its algebra
  structure on `Ω`.
- `decompositionResidueField F A` for a field `F` with `[IsGalois F Ω]`
  (M243.003, module
  `Langlands.NYLL.ValuedFieldTheory.Ramification.HilbertRamification.ResidueExactSequence.Definitions`)
  is the quotient of the fixed subring `A^{D_F}` of `A` by the contraction of
  the maximal ideal of `A`. Here `D_F = decompositionGroup F A` is the
  subgroup of `Gal(Ω / F)` of automorphisms `σ` with `σ • A = A`. This is
  the base residue field `κ` of the residue-action exact sequence over `F`.
  The definition uses it twice: with `F = K`, giving `κ_K`, and with
  `F = E`, giving `κ_E`.
- `selectedResidueField A` (M243.004, same module) is
  `IsLocalRing.ResidueField A`, the residue field `λ` of `A`. The source
  docstring calls it the "selected residue algebraic closure". The
  published target `localSelectedResidueIsAlgClosedStatement` (M249.016)
  states that it is algebraically closed. This definition does not use that
  fact.

`localSeparableValuationSubring` and `abstractFixedField` are in the
namespace `Langlands.NYLL.LocalClassFieldTheory`.
`decompositionResidueField` and `selectedResidueField` are in
`Langlands.NYLL.RamificationTheory.HilbertRamification.ValuationSubring`.

## Instances used by the type and the body

Typeclass search supplies, in the approved environment:

- `IsGalois K (SeparableClosure K)`: Mathlib's
  `separableClosure.isGalois K (AlgebraicClosure K)`;
- `IsGalois E (SeparableClosure K)`: Mathlib's
  `IsGalois.tower_top_intermediateField E`;
- `Field (decompositionResidueField K A)`: the published instance
  `decompositionResidueField.instField K A` (M243.020, module
  `Langlands.NYLL.ValuedFieldTheory.Ramification.HilbertRamification.ResidueExactSequence.ResidueFields`).
  It is `Ideal.Quotient.field` for the maximal contracted ideal;
- `Algebra (decompositionResidueField F A) (selectedResidueField A)`, for
  `F = K` in the type and `F = E` in `algebraMap kE Omega`: the published
  instance `selectedResidueField.instAlgebra F A` (M243.021, same module).
  It is `Ideal.Quotient.algebraQuotientOfLEComap`: a class `[a]` with
  `a ∈ A^{D_F}` maps to the residue class of `a` in `λ`;
- the field structure of `λ` and the remaining structure on `E`: Mathlib's
  instances for residue fields of local rings and for intermediate fields.

A development probe confirmed these instance names with `#synth`. The
definition declares no instance.

## What the definition means

`IntermediateField.adjoin k S` is the smallest intermediate field of `λ / κ_K`
containing the set `S`. Here `S` is the image of `κ_E` in `λ`. So
`localAbstractFixedResidueIntermediateField K H` is the compositum of the
images of `κ_K` and `κ_E` in `λ`, viewed as an extension of `κ_K`.

The source docstring explains the choice of `adjoin`: it avoids imposing a
scalar-tower instance between the two residue-action quotient presentations
`κ_K` and `κ_E`. The definition does not claim that the image of `κ_E`
contains the image of `κ_K`, or that the adjoined field equals the image of
`κ_E`. The later source theorems about this field are separate units (see
below).

## Binders and universes

The binders are those of the source section, unchanged: the explicit field
`(K : Type)`, the instances `[Field K] [ValuativeRel K] [TopologicalSpace K]
[IsNonarchimedeanLocalField K]`, and the explicit closed subgroup
`(H : ClosedSubgroup (Gal(SeparableClosure K/K)))`. `ClosedSubgroup` and the
notation `Gal(L/K)` for `L ≃ₐ[K] L` are Mathlib's. As in the source, `K`
lives in `Type`, so the declaration has no universe parameter.

The direct imports are the three published modules named above:

- `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.LocalClassFieldTheory.Finite.LocalReciprocity.LocalResidueDatum.U006.Definitions`
  (`localSeparableValuationSubring`);
- `Langlands.NYLL.ClassFieldTheory.LocalClassFieldTheory.Finite.LocalReciprocity.FiniteAbstractFixedField.Initial.Definitions`
  (`abstractFixedField`);
- `Langlands.NYLL.ValuedFieldTheory.Ramification.HilbertRamification.ResidueExactSequence.ResidueFields`
  (the instances M243.020 and M243.021; through its imports also
  `decompositionResidueField` and `selectedResidueField`).

They replace the source's two imports (`LocalResidueDatum` and
`FiniteAbstractFixedField`), which also serve the other declarations of the
source file. Every transitive import lies in the approved Mathlib environment
or the published Library.

header records the change. The changes are:

The `noncomputable section`, the `variable` line, the docstring, the binders,
the type and the body (source lines 33–52, compared line by line with lines

The module compiled with zero errors and zero warnings in approved environment

## Use downstream

In the source file, this intermediate field carries local `Algebra`, `SMul`
and `Module` instances over `κ_K` (M250.002–M250.004, lines 54–79; the port
plan assigns them private `PortInternal.M250` names). The source then
restricts the residue action of `H` to automorphisms of `λ` over this
intermediate field (`localAbstractFixedResidueActionOverIntermediateField`,
M250.009). It proves that the field is finite-dimensional over `κ_K` when `H`
has finite index (`localAbstractFixedResidueIntermediateField_finiteDimensional`,
M250.011), and packages it as a finite Galois intermediate field (M250.012).
Finally it identifies the residue degree that `localResidueDatum` attaches to
a finite abstract field with the rank of this field over `κ_K`
(`localResidueDatum_residueDegree_eq_selectedResidueFinrank`, M250.013).
None of these is part of this module.
